name: Squat
technique: Feet shoulder-width, chest upright, knees track over toes, hips back and down.
mistakes: Knees caving inward, heels lifting, insufficient depth.
beginner: Bodyweight squat to a chair.
advanced: Loaded back squat or jump squat.

name: Push-up
technique: Straight line from head to heels, elbows ~45° from torso, full range of motion.
mistakes: Sagging hips, flaring elbows, partial range.
beginner: Incline or knee push-up.
advanced: Deficit or weighted push-up.

name: Lunge
technique: Step forward (or hold split stance), lower until both knees are near 90°, front knee tracks over the ankle, torso stays upright.
mistakes: Front knee traveling past the toes, leaning the torso far forward, shallow depth, wobbling for balance.
beginner: Static split-squat holds instead of stepping, using a wall or chair for balance.
advanced: Walking lunges or reverse lunges with added load.

name: Vertical Jump
technique: Quick countermovement dip, drive arms up, extend hips-knees-ankles fully at takeoff, land softly.
mistakes: Shallow countermovement, stiff landings, uneven takeoff.
beginner: Practice the landing mechanics before maximizing jump height.
advanced: Add approach steps for a run-up jump.

name: Plank
technique: Straight line from head to heels, brace the core, neutral neck.
mistakes: Hips sagging or piking, holding breath.
beginner: Shorter holds or knee plank.
advanced: Longer holds or added instability.

name: Jumping Jack
technique: Land softly, knees slightly bent, full arm extension overhead.
mistakes: Locking knees on landing, shallow arm range.
beginner: Half-jacks (step out) at a slower pace.
advanced: Add a squat at the bottom.

name: Pull-up
technique: Full hang start, pull until chin clears the bar, control the descent to a full hang.
mistakes: Kipping/swinging for momentum, only partial range at the top or bottom.
beginner: Band-assisted pull-ups or negative-only reps (jump up, lower slowly).
advanced: Weighted pull-ups or wide-grip variations.

name: Dip
technique: Lower with control until shoulders are near elbow height, press back up without flaring elbows excessively.
mistakes: Going too deep and straining the shoulder joint, leaning too far forward (shifts to chest-only) or staying upright (shifts to triceps-only) without intent.
beginner: Bench dips with feet on the floor, knees bent.
advanced: Weighted dips.

name: Burpee
technique: Drop to a plank, chest to floor, jump feet back to hands, explode upward into a jump.
mistakes: Sagging hips in the plank phase, skipping the full chest-to-floor lowering, no full hip extension at the top.
beginner: Step feet back one at a time instead of jumping; skip the push-up phase.
advanced: Add a tuck jump or a push-up at the bottom.

name: Mountain Climber
muscles: Core, hip flexors, shoulders, cardiovascular system
technique: Plank position, drive knees alternately toward the chest at speed while keeping hips level.
mistakes: Hips rising too high (piking), losing the plank line, feet not fully returning back.
beginner: Slow, controlled reps rather than fast ones.
advanced: Increase speed or add a slider/gliding disc.

name: Glute Bridge
technique: Lie on your back, knees bent, drive hips up until the body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, squeeze at the top.
mistakes: Overarching the lower back instead of using the glutes, not reaching full hip extension.
beginner: Smaller range of motion, focus on the squeeze at the top.
advanced: Single-leg glute bridge or add a barbell (hip thrust).

name: Superman
technique: Lie face down, simultaneously lift arms, chest and legs a few inches off the floor, hold briefly, lower with control.
mistakes: Yanking upward instead of a controlled lift, holding the breath.
beginner: Lift arms and legs on alternating sides instead of all at once.
advanced: Add a longer hold at the top.

name: Deadlift
muscles: Hamstrings, glutes, lower back, traps, grip
technique: Bar over midfoot, flat back, hinge at the hips, drive through the floor to stand tall, hips and shoulders rising together.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back, letting the bar drift away from the shins, hips rising faster than the chest.
beginner: Romanian deadlift with light weight or a kettlebell to learn the hip hinge first.
advanced: Conventional or sumo deadlift with progressive loading.

name: Bench Press
technique: Shoulder blades retracted, controlled bar path to the mid-chest, press back up in a slight arc without bouncing the bar.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest, flaring elbows to 90°, lifting hips off the bench.
beginner: Push-ups or a light dumbbell press to groove the pressing pattern.
advanced: Add pause reps or incline variations.

name: Overhead Press
technique: Bar starts at the collarbone, press straight overhead while bracing the core, avoid excessive lower-back arch.
mistakes: Pressing the bar forward instead of straight up, arching the lower back to gain range.
beginner: Seated dumbbell press for more stability while learning the pattern.
advanced: Standing barbell press with strict form, or push press for more load.

name: Barbell Row
muscles: Upper back, lats, biceps, rear shoulders
technique: Hinge forward with a flat back, pull the bar to the lower ribs, squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
mistakes: Standing too upright (turns it into a shrug), using momentum/jerking the weight up.
beginner: Single-arm dumbbell row with support from a bench.
advanced: Pendlay row (bar resets on the floor each rep).

name: Bicep Curl
technique: Elbows pinned to the sides, curl through a full range without swinging the torso.
mistakes: Using body momentum to swing the weight up, only completing a partial range.
beginner: Lighter dumbbells with slow, controlled tempo.
advanced: Add pause reps at the top or slow eccentrics.

name: Box Jump
technique: Countermovement dip, drive arms up, land softly on the box with knees slightly bent, step down (don't jump down).
mistakes: Jumping back down off the box (high impact risk), landing with stiff knees.
beginner: Start with a low box or step and focus on a soft landing.
advanced: Increase box height progressively.

name: Standing Broad Jump
technique: Swing arms back then forward explosively while extending hips-knees-ankles to jump as far forward as possible, land balanced on both feet.
mistakes: Jumping upward instead of forward, landing off-balance or falling backward.
beginner: Focus on a controlled, balanced landing before maximizing distance.
advanced: Chain multiple broad jumps together for a distance series.

name: High Knees
muscles: Hip flexors, quadriceps, calves, cardiovascular system
technique: Drive knees up toward hip height rapidly while staying on the balls of the feet, keep the torso tall.
mistakes: Leaning back, knees not reaching hip height, slow/lazy cadence.
beginner: Slower marching version to learn the knee drive.
advanced: Increase cadence or add it into interval sprints.

name: Russian Twist
technique: Seated with torso leaned back slightly, feet lifted or grounded, rotate the torso side to side under control.
mistakes: Rotating only the arms instead of the torso, rounding the lower back.
beginner: Keep feet on the floor for more stability.
advanced: Add a weight plate or medicine ball, lift the feet off the floor.
